notes.title: Phase 2 Remaster Update!
notes.content:
[u][b]Welcome back Volunteers to Anna: The Series Test! Dr. Alleyne is all too excited to share with you what she's been working on while she's been away![/b][/u]

[i]First things first, I am well too aware that I should have given you all an update on what was going on behind the scenes months ago; and for that I can only apologize. At the beginning of this year I lost one of my immediate family members and that loss completely threw my whole motivation for working on this game out. All these years I've been creating Anna: The Series Test, this family member was the one who I was always discussing ideas, routes and literally anything else I had planned, with.
[/i]
[i]Truthfully, they were my main motivation and losing them just killed me. Afterwards, I did try getting back into working, yet without having them by my side to bounce ideas off, I just couldn't. However; recently I've been coping better and in an attempt to get my motivation back I have gone back and remastered nearly all of phase 2.[/i]

[b]Okay, with that out the way let's move on to what's new! This update brings with 1809 remastered renders to phase 2 and 3. Plus 13 remastered videos![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40401367/1347a360fa5ccd96189ddade9db27f44f3846f62.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40401367/be1e233bb6e368b090cc36409a1567867948fe4e.png[/img]

Some of these new renders you may have already seen as I've been slowly trickling out updates over the last couple of months as each section has been remade, and these small updates will continue over the near future. Today though comes the biggest of the small updates yet! Which is a full remaster of Alleyne's date event, Cherry fantasy date event, and Freya's phase 3 romance/cherry event.

The scenes affected and remastered are:
[list]
[*] Aiko's missing event. - Where she breaks into your apartment after noticing Kiyomi's disappearance. - Phase 2.
[*] Alleyne's date event. - The nightclub scene where your re-romance with Dr. Alleyne begins. - Phase 2. (New Video renders here.)
[*] Alma's Phase 2. - The beginning half has been remastered, including Aiko's appearance. (The second part where she's at the park will be updated soon.)
[*] Cherry's Phase 2. - All of Cherry's second phase has been updated. From her home to your picnic, it's all new. Plus Kiyomi's appearance.
[*] Cherry's fantasy date event. - Whether your going as friends or a couple, Cherry's night out has all been fully remastered, with a new dance routine and sexual scenes. (New Video renders here.)
[*] Freya and Alma's hookup. - Think this is the oldest of the remasters, but stumbling upon the cop and recluse now looks a lot crisper. (New Video renders here.)
[*] Freya's Phase 2 - The entire of Freya's phase 2 has been remastered, whether you find her with Alma or alone. Plus a new outfit is showcased. (New Video renders here.)
[*] Home event Phase 2. - The ending of phase 2 with Alleyne and your conversations with her prior have all been remastered. New outfit and hairstyle.
[*] Kiyomi's Phase 2. - All of Kiyomi's rampage has been remastered, with all of it's side sections, which there are plenty. Waking up beside Alleyne, Cherry, Alma, Alma and Aiko, or alone... It's all been remade with a new outfit for Series Shores best assassin. (New Video renders here.)
[*] Freya's missing event. - After evicting Cherry in phase 2, Freya's sadness is now all remastered, alongside her romancing. New sexual content. (New Video renders here.)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40401367/100c63ec3ae48f03171705c4ab3729d1f7903a2f.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40401367/c39aaf6671d41ec8361b154a324e516c4f824dc0.png[/img]

That's about it for what's new! With regards to when the ending will finally be upon us, rest assured I am hard at work on scripting and rendering; however, there is an insane amount of endings and each one is unique which requires a ton of writing and planning! I am honestly so sorry about making you all wait, but I cant bring myself to rush out a finale when everything else has been so personalised and perfected. All these little updates have really inspired me to get back into working though so full steam ahead!! 

[b]Thank you all again for your patience and support in this dream of mine, and I will return with more good news soon! Lastly, below is a showcase of some changes, the new renders above with the old identical ones below.[/b]

notes.title: Ending Phase Outfit Showcase + Update News!
notes.content:
[b]Welcome back Volunteers! This announcement is simply a brief update on what's been going on behind the scenes and a showcase of the new outfits coming in the ending phase![/b]

Since the phase 5 release a month or two back, I've been pretty quiet on what's been going on with The Series Test, but you'll be happy to know I've been hard at work on the endings and getting everything ready for the full release, which will be the next update. [i]Hopefully this won't be too long now.[/i]

[b]As far as the endings go, there is roughly about 10 unique endings per replica. This is all based off the affinity system, giving you either a good or bad end based off relationship, then also being matched with what you chose in phase 5 will give various endings. (Not including Kiyomi and Alma)[/b]

Take Freya as a rough example with this:

If you have a good affinity with Freya you'll get a good end; but, if you choose 'option 1' in phase 5 you will get 1 unique version good ending, but if you chose 'option 2' you'll get placed on a different unique good ending. Same with bad and bad endings affinity. And then this will change again based on who you're dating and what you've done throughout. (The example below doesn't include any 'double ends' with two replicas as Freya doesn't have any. Not any what are set up on her side at least.)

[olist]
[*] Good affinity + Option 1 = Ending 1
[*] Good affinity + Option 2 = Ending 2
[*] Bad affinity + Option 1 = Ending 3
[*] Bad affinity + Option 2 = Ending 4
[*] Extremely Good affinity + Option 1 = Secret Ending

[*] Good affinity + Option 1 + Dating Alleyne = Ending 5
[*] Good affinity + Option 2 + Dating Alleyne = Ending 6
[*] Bad affinity + Option 1 + Dating Alleyne = Ending 7
[*] Bad affinity + Option 2 + Dating Alleyne = Ending 8

[*] Good affinity + Jordana/Cherry Lose Route = Ending 9
[*] Bad affinity + Jordana/Cherry Lose Route = Bad Ending

[*] Freya was First Eviction and took the Ghost route? = Freya 'Ghost' End.
[/olist]
[i]Hopefully this makes some sort of sense and explains why creating the endings is taking so long as its not a case of 1 end per replica. I think all in all there's about 62 unique ends... But this can change. Already I've got most of the Alleyne version of the endings done and I've completed Cherry's date route.[/i] 

Plus, I didn't make an announcement on this, but for those of you who haven't already seen, I recently went back and re-rendered the first date sequence between Alma and Freya. Which included a new outfit for each of them and 2 new video renders for the scene, plus other little fixes. 

Alma and Freya's 'romance' scene was the first full video render I ever did and I was never really too happy with how it looked, so now my skills have improved, I've gone back and corrected this. Along with a few Cherry and Alleyne renders too. [i]I'll showcase this below also.[/i] 

[i][b]Unless this next update takes a drastically long time, which I hope it shouldn't, this will be the last announcement before the next release. So if anyone has any ideas or comments which you think will improve the game before full release, please drop them in the comments because I'd love to hear nay suggestions.[/b][/i]

notes.title: Anna The Series Test: Phase 5 Release, plus new in-game guide!
notes.content:
[u][b]Good News Volunteers! Anna The Series Test: Phase 5 release is finally upon us! Plus there's now an in-game guide! But... The Series Test isn't over![/b][/u]

Dr Alleyne welcomes you all back to Series Shores Volunteers for the new phase 5 update! She's been hard at work preparing the next phase of the test for you and she can't wait to show you all what she's been working on! This phase you'll be travelling deep inside Aiko's mind, solving a murder case with Sheriff Way and exploring forgotten cities and beautiful mountain tops with the Valentina girls! But... There is a catch.

I should probably start with the catch, so phase 5 is releasing, but this is not the final version of Anna: The Series Test. Instead this is version 0.95, the next release will be the final version. What this means is you can play the game up until the end of phase 5 now, yet currently there's no ending to the game.
 
[b]Why am I releasing phase 5 without the ending?[/b] The main reason for this is because there's going to be so many unique and varied endings in the full version, it's going to take me some time to get these complete. So in the mean time I'm releasing phase 5 so you can get a full round experience with the girls of Series Shores and see how their phases close off, before the ending of the game comes.

[b]So, although this is the new phase 5 update, this only includes 6 new scenes which close off phase 5 from where you last left off.[/b] There is one for each replica, and two for Alma as her path split back in phase 3. (The seventh scene for Aer's replica was released a month back.) There are no new scenes for Alleyne, but her phase 1 and 2 renders have been updated to newer versions.

Alongside this update, there is now a fully functional in-game guide which can be accessed from the main menu and the quick menu while in the game. This includes how to unlock all the True Routes, the date routes, the secret routes and events. Plus some secret events in the game you may not have found.
[i]There's always been a guide in the discussions but it's easily missed and a hassle to keep switching back and fourth to see where you want to go, so now you can easily plan out your test while in game from the menus and then follow that path all the way through.[/i]

[b]All this unfortunately means this update is smaller than the usual updates with only 850+ new renders, 6 new scenes for the normal mode and 6 scenes for fantasy mode. Kiyomi Sasaki is now romanceable. [/b](It's early for her relationship so full scenes will come with the ending update. Although if you really want to make some sweet love to Kiyomi, follow her and Alma's true route.)

Okay so what does this new phase offer?
[list]
[*] Jump into Aiko's mind and get to know her inner demon as you come face to face with Ymir Michiyo, but will you choose to set Ymir free or stay with the Princess you know?
[*] Go back to school with Kiyomi and relive her worst memory, but it will be your choice whether she decides to face this memory head on or cower away. 
[*] Take a trip to Artificial New York with Cherry as she shows you what her life was like before she lost her mother. Cherry doesn't want to go to war, will you force her?
[*] Scale a mountain with Freya and see what she looked like before she became the giantess of Apex.
[*] Depending on what route you chose to take with Sheriff Way, you'll either be solving the case of Series Shores serial killer or you be tunnelling down into one of The Mother's human farms and hearing about the horrors she committed.
[*] Perhaps you chose to keep Aer as you victor? Take a stroll down memory lane and met the woman who raised the Xiao's. A mothers guidance is always appreciated.
[/list]

okay, without any further delays, here are a few renders form the new update and Dr Alleyne hopes to see you back in Series Shores ready for the end of her test!!

[i]For those of you who may be wondering why the Volunteer/Aer-dula is blonde in this update, Alma's date route has the answer to that question. You visiting past memories and Aer is a natural blonde.[/i]
[i]Also, as with all updates, there may be bugs, but due to the size and amount of different varying paths it's hard to find them all, if there is any. Already I have thoroughly tested the game and found none and will continue checking. However, if you do find any, please let me know in the discussions.[/i]

notes.title: Small update to town intro - Font fix - New GUI and small bug fix. (09-06-2023)
notes.content:
[b]Good evening Volunteers![/b]

I haven't really got much to say here, this is only small news of an update which will be rolling out within the next hour which will change the beginning town intro scene. The renders and such will stay the same, but all the scripting and interactions you have with the replicas has been edited to more fitting with their personalities.

I've already mentioned before about how I've gone back and changed the early game to make it more in-line with the rest of the game as my skills developed, same thing has happened here really. As the game developed so did the replicas personalities and it no longer felt like this beginning intro reflected who they are.

Freya's supposed to start off cold towards you and grow from there, as one example. Also having Kiyomi telling you to F*** off in the first five seconds didn't fit who she is. She's heartless toward you, but not crude. So yeah, this is just a small script change to make the replicas feel more like themselves. Encase anyone was wondering what was changed.

[b]Still hard at work on phase 5 and now only Kiyomi's scene left to complete. Good news there! Enjoy your weekends Volunteers![/b]

(An edit to this update, today the game has also been updated with a new GUI textbox as the due to the transparency on the previous one, it was sometimes difficult to read the text. Hopefully this new GUI will correct that problem. Also the default text could be difficult to read, there was always the option to change font in the preferences, but this wasn't always picked up upon. So the new default text is more clean and easy to read. You can still change your choice in the preferences menu.) 

(Lastly, I recently noticed a bug where if you were on Aiko's true route and selected Freya to evict at the end of phase 3, it would crash the game. I believe this a new bug released in a recent update, either way, it is now fixed.)

notes.title: 2 Year Anniversary Update! New Content!
notes.content:
[b][u]Good News Volunteers! A new update for Anna: The Series Test is now available![/u][/b]

Recently the 2 year anniversary of The Series Test passed and I missed it! I've been so caught up on working on phase 5 and the endings so I can have the game released in its full version this year, that I let this milestone pass by. But, good news, today I'm releasing a small content update to celebrate. 

[i]Admittedly this is a very small update with only one new added scene with about 35 renders and one new soundtrack. But, it's a start for what's to come next.[/i]

For those of you who have taken Alei-yin's route, you may have seen you have the option to pick Aer's replica as your finally candidate if you followed closely enough; and admittedly, I always felt guilty for leaving this end the way it was for the phase 4 release. With all the other replicas you were given the final scene with the portal, yet with Aer, you never got this. It just sort of faded out.

So this update is an apology to our favourite Volunteer! After all, The Series Test would be nothing without Aer.

Releasing today is an additional scene which will come after your final pick if you have chosen Aer as your final candidate. In this scene you will be visiting someone very special to her and asking for advice on where to go next. Adding in a whole lot of emotional depth and understanding to why the Xiao's are close as they are now. [b]Here are a few teasers from this update.[/b]

It's no secret I'm not a fan of the original phase 1 and 2 renders, and that I've been going back and re-working them when I have the time. notes.title: Anna: The Series Test, Phase 4 Release is Finally Here!
notes.content:
[b]Excellent news Volunteers! After spending ten long months in the Alleyne's lab, Anna: The Series Test phase 4 is finally here, and playable now! Dr Alleyne can't wait to share with you all what she's been working on![/b]

This phase is jam-packed with content from start to finish, plus reworked scenes from the original release. This phase is going to push you into the hardest choice you've made in The Series Test so far and it's going to be asking you; [i] who's your victor for The Series Test?[/i]

Phase four is going to have you walking through Alleyne's test and connecting with her replica's while they are at their most emotional state. Each replica has encountered The Mother in some way or another in their previous, cloned, lives. Now this phase you'll be visiting the replica's in their homes all so you can ask them the most important questions of all. [b] Who is The Mother? How do you know her? And, can you end her rebirth?[/b]

So, what has Alleyne prepared for you this phase? Let's find out:

[b] - Kiyomi Sasaki: [/b]

This phase you'll be visiting Kiyomi's private abode trying to figure what exactly it is the master assassin knows. Only problem is, while you've been laying out your plans, Kiyomi's been making plans of her own.  What's Kiyomi really been up to this whole time you've been loitering around Series Shores, and how much of what she's found out will she be willing to share with you?

Kiyomi story comes to a decisive choice this phase which lay you on the path of betrayal or mutual trust. Does Kiyomi care enough to let you make the choice or will she make it herself? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40401367/4f478ee164bfab47eb1970669d9c9b535e3775a8.jpg[/img]

[b] - Aiko Michiyo-Sasaki: [/b]

Every single time you've encountered the princess of insanity thus far, she's been a unpredictable cannon of sheer violence and madness. Now you're catching Princess Aiko in her own home, will she be stable? Stable as she can be at least.

Aiko holds the key to The Mother's previous demise and that is a key you so desperately need. But what exactly happened when Aiko encountered The Mother last time, and why did she do what she did? Time to step into insanities lair and find out.

[b] - Alma Way: [/b]

Sheriff Alma Way has always been somewhat of a wild card. She wants you think she trusts you, you want to trust her, but do you? Does she? What did you do in phase three? Did you spill the beans to the Sheriff or have you played your cards close to your chest?

Depending on what you chose in phase 3, depends on where Alma's phase goes this time as it splits into two paths. Are you planning to have the Sheriff help you blow Series Shores wide open or do you want to keep her locked in her own mind doing your bidding?

[b] - Cherry Valentina: [/b]

Cherry Valentina has been so excited to show you all the treasures Series Shores offers. She's been happy to live in her own world ignoring the darkest sides of life her replica sisters hold. Yet what will she do when you bring the darker side to her doorstep?

This phase you'll be meeting Cherry in her home, or yours if you're loved up, while trying to uncover whether Cherry has a darker side lurking within. A darker side you're going to need if you ever want to stop The Mother's threat. After all these months though, have you hardened Cherry's resolve or has she softened yours? 

[b] - Freya Valentina: [/b]

The most tortured soul in Series Shores, Freya Valentina, is she still in your test or was her hatred toward your kind too much for you to handle? This phase you'll be learning all about Freya's history and why she detests humanity so much. Is her hatred just, or is this a woman who's bottled up so many bad memories that she's now bound to explode?

Freya only wants to live a peaceful life. She's been through the worst and now only wishes to hide away from the rest of the world. Question is, are you going to let her? Or is the power she holds too much to pass up on? Even if it means destroying another's life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40401367/7ebc05a01d8480dac470186999673a9b25792907.jpg[/img]

[b] - Alei-yin Xiao: [/b]

Alei-yin has more content in this phase than she's ever had before and this time she'll fill in all the blanks you been holding onto for months. Who is Apex? Who is The Mother? Who are you?

Plus, after phase three's heated ending, the cold doctor has some explaining to do herself. What exactly has she been doing to the replicas once you push their buttons? Find out in phase 4.

[b] So, as you can see there is lots of content going on in phase 4 and that's just explaining the basic routes without dipping into the variations each one has, or the secret routes where things will go a little  off course. [/b] [i] As always I will warn that due to the amount of varying paths in this game, to see all the new content will require more than one playthrough. If you are playing on one route there is loads of content for you, but there is more elsewhere.[/i]

[u]Update notes and content include in the new update:[/u]
[list]
[*] Full new scenes for each replica's standard visit, with HD renders and stories. Plus variations of these stories based on your affinity with each replica and who still remains.
- Kiyomi's event has 3 variations.
- Aiko's event has 3 variations. - plus a secret Cherry route.
- Alma's event has 4 variations. - plus a love route and a secret Aiko route.
- Freya's event has 3 variations.
- Cherry's event has 3 variations. - plus a secret Aiko route.

[*] 5 New home scenes for Alei-yin if you are following her route and 3 new scenes for Cherry if you are following her date route. Each with choices to be made which affect your test and what you've done so far.
[*] A continuation of the Haunting storyline. Which is tailored to which replica has been stalking you.
[*] 2 continuation scenes which carry on from where you left off in phase 3 and who you left of with.
[*] Make your final choice and see where you last choice is leading you to. Plus uncover a new player which has come to town. Is she willing to help or would she rather hinder?
[*] Alma Way has finally become a romantic option for you to pursue, but can you keep the love contained to you two or is another woman needed?
[*] 2 new true routes have been introduced in this phase. Where will these varying choices lead you to?
- An Alma/Kiyomi route.
- A clone Aer-dula route.

[*] Secret routes come into play this phase. Giving you the option of having more than one final candidate for your test. Will you stumble upon any?
- Alma/Freya - lovers route.
- Alma/Aiko - lovers route.
- Aiko/Kiyomi - lovers route.
- Aiko/Cherry - lovers route.
- Cherry/Freya - Family route.

[*] There are now 29 possible endings to the game in it's current state. Some are unique, others are variations. All will lead to different endings in the final phase.

[*] 3,400+ new full quality HD renders.
[*] 17 new short animations.
[*] 60,000 new lines of code.
[*] Alma's, Kiyomi's and Cherry's phase 1 scenes have all be re-rendered and adjusted. (Aiko's and Freya's are coming soon.)
[*] The checklists have been updated to give a cleaner and more precise view of what's been missed.
[*] All maps have been redone to make them more clean and fit more with the new style. Plus a new main menu screen.
[*] Various bug fixes and spelling corrections have been made.

[/list]

[b] For those of you who have the Volume 1 Render DLC, good news here too as within the next day there is an update coming to that which will include 80+ new 4k renders. Keep an eye out for that. [/b]

[i] Now to share some bad news, the gallery has not been updated with this phase as I am looking into changing the whole gallery system to make it more streamlined. Any of the true routes which could be ended on in phase 3 have not been complete as of yet, they are going to be in the next update. Lastly The Xiao Trials has not had any major updates, but that too should come in the next update. [/i]

[b] So that's where we are Volunteers! Phase four is finally here bringing tons of content with it and I can't wait for you all to jump in. If you have any comments or questions please feel free to drop them in the discussions or contact me, because I love hearing from the community about what is working well and what can be improved.

As for this, there is currently a guide in the discussions on how to unlock each true route. I will be updating that soon with the new true routes, the new date routes, and the secret endings.

Why don't you take your next dip into Series Shores Volunteers and take the last step toward ending your test. Alleyne's been waiting for you. [/b]

notes.title: Update news and planned release for next update!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Volunteers! This is has been long overdue, so now I think it's time I give you all an update on what's been going on behind  the scenes, plus the planned release schedule for the next update![/b]

[i]First and foremost, this  announcement is going to be both good and bad news. I'll sour you all with the bad news first and then move onto the good news once this paragraph is over. Get it out the way, so to speak.[/i]

[b][i]So bad news first; an update is going to be coming soon, but it's only going to be a core storyline update. (Main story and fantasy mode.) This means it won't have any true route updates or any Xiao Trials updates coming with it. Those will be released shortly after once they are complete. This also means the update may feel shorter, however it's come to a time where a core update is better than no update. I am sorry for the delay.[/i][/b] [i]This core story-line update will take you to your final choice and end after.[/i]

[i]This is due to my living situation drastically changing recently, and therefor having taken claim to some of the time I dedicate to creating The Series Test. Over the last two months I've gone from living alone to taking care of two nephews and a busy house... Big change, you could imagine. So the game is still being worked on, however the next update will be 0.87 and then 0.9 when the true routes are released too. Also I will be stopping my patreon at the end of this month as I no longer have the time to make new and fresh wallpapers for there, but I am still building a collection to add to the DLC upon 0.9 release.[/i]

[b]On to the good news! When is the next update? Within the next 30 days![/b]

Unfortunately I can't give an exact day count, but I am in the final stages of completing everything necessary to get through phase 4 and onto your last choice. The hardest choice by far. Even though this update is going to be missing the true routes and Xiao Trails update, and it may feel short on one playthrough, [b]it is anything but.[/b]

This phase is going to be jam-packed with so much varying content that you'll missing out if you don't seek it all:
[list]
[*]Three new true routes come into play this phase which will play out to the phase 4 end:
    - An Cherry/Kiyomi route.
    - An Alma/Kiyomi route.
    - A clone Aer-dula route.
[*] Opposed to the true routes there is now build ups to secret endings. (These vary from true routes as true routes drastically change the story, where as secret routes offer a secret base end.):
     - Alma/Freya - lovers route.
     - Aiko/Kiyomi - lovers route.
     - Aiko/Cherry - lovers route.
     - Cherry/Freya - Family route.
     - A new Alma love route.
     - A new Kiyomi love route.
[*] Alei-yin is going to have five different home visit options this phase. (Each replica leads to a home event with Alei, and depending on which two you have remaining decides which two you will get to see on that run.)
[*] With the replica's, this phase will hold loads of content there too:
     - Kiyomi's event has 3 variations. 
     - Aiko's event has 3 variations. - plus a secret Cherry route.
     - Alma's event has 4 variations. - plus a love route and a secret Aiko route.
     - Freya's event has 3 variations.
     - Cherry's event has 3 variations. - plus a secret Aiko route.
     - Alei-yin event has 3 variations. - plus all her extra's if you're dating.
     - Haunted event has 5 variations. 
[*] There are no special events this phase. But some may be included with update 0.9.
[*] Currently there are 2,500+ new renders, plus various video renders. (Including two love scenes with Alma.)
[*] A new map has been implemented replacing the old one. It is similar in style, but more clean then the previous.
[*] After last phases cliff-hanger, there is two different ways that can come to some understanding before phase 4. An Alei-yin explanation and a Cherry/single explanation.
[*] 30,000 + lines of code have been added.
[*] If time allows, there will also be a new gallery implemented into the game making it more seamless and dedicated to each replica than the free-for-all it is now.
[/list]

Now all of this is going to come with the 0.87 update within the next month. Once that has been rolled out I am going to finish working on closing the six true routes which started last update, then finally on to the end. [b][i]We're getting the Volunteers! I appreciate all your patience.[/i][/b]

[b]So yeah, something to look forward to in the coming thirty days! I will give an event announcement prior to it's arrival, and below I'm going to include a few of my favourite renders from this phase so far![/b]

[i] Any questions or suggestions, anything at all, drop it in the discussions, email me or comment here. Love to hear from you. :) [/i]

notes.title: **UPDATE: BOTH DLC'S ARE NOW LIVE!!**
notes.content:
[b]We're finally here Volunteers! The first, and hopefully second, DLC release!! Dr Alleyne can't wait to show you what she's been working on![/b]

So releasing today, and hopefully over the next few days, is not one but two DLC add-ons coming for Anna: The Series Test! Going to be upfront about this first, the DLC isn't any story add-on, it's simply artwork and lore. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2098900/Anna_Series__4K_Artwork_Renders/]Encase the DLC isn't shown on the store page, get it here.[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2098901/Anna_Series__Novel_Bundle/]And you can find The Anna Series Novels here.[/url]

[b]The first DLC which should be going live any second now is 200+ 4k renders/wallpapers of all your favourite replicas.[/b] Whether the giantess Freya Valentina or the cocky Alma Way is your flavour, maybe even the Xiao's are your thing, either way you are going to be covered here. 

Over 200 renders of all the gals you've come to know and love in Series Shores in a mismatch of scenarios. Some are adult themed while others will be more acceptable with your family. It isn't even just the replicas getting involved, it's everyone! From the the weirdly loveable Xiao's to the true woman who our replicas are based off. The best news?! It's going to keep on growing!! For free!
That's right, get the DLC now and it will updated again upon the release of the phase 4 update! Great news, best news as our beloved Aiko would say.

[i]The reason for this is because these renders are a collection of all the renders I've released over on my patreon over the last few months and I release new renders every two weeks. So get them there early, or wait and when I release phase 4 I'm going to update this volume with any new ones which will release between now and then.[/i]

Lovign scenes like this? Well, there's atleast 200 more where these come from.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40401367/a08f42299f100d43878697c3a4b9fd932f8c957c.jpg[/img]

[b]The second DLC, which is still going through the process of getting reviewed and I pray it makes it, Is all four novels Anna: The Series Test is based off in PDF form.[/b]

Four complete novels  for the price of one paperback release! Dr Alleyne loves to offer a bargain where she can. So if your aching to learn more about your favourite replica why not pick up their origin story and uncover all those mysterious details who made them who they were? No better time really, not now that the woman from the novels have started appearing all over Series Shores in the true routes!

In the first novel you'll learn all about our favourite detective Alma Way. Book two offers a tale of Kiyomi's daring prison escape and revenge against Little Tokyo. In book three you'll span a decade learning the origins of Freya and the Anna. Lastly book 4 is a two part story telling the twisted birth of our beloved Princess Aiko and a detailed memoir written by Cherry who's seeking a mother!


[i]To be honest again, I'm not sure whether story DLC is on the cards for The Series Test at the moment. My original plan was to make The Xiao Trials DLC, but you've all already supported me so much through this journey I wanted to give you something in return. Maybe once The Series Test is complete, but I already have a concept in mind for a second release..... We'll see how it goes.[/i]

[b] Thanks again Volunteers! You are all awesome!! Each and every one of you![/b]

notes.title: The Xiao Trials Update + Intro Rework!
notes.content:
[b]It's finally here! Well, a tease of it is here. Today you can make your start in The Xiao Trials![/b]

I think I've spoken about this before, but upon full release of The Series Test, there will be a new game mode included called The Xiao Trials. In this mode you will take control of Dr Alleyne herself as she tries to make it through her own test.

Now unlike Aer-dula's test, which is all player choice with the evictions, this new mode will be completely random  and based off a random number generator. At the beginning of each phase the game will roll and random number and that phase the corresponding replica will malfunction magnificently! It's the Series Test but fully randomized!!

This mode is still a work in progress and the first proper draft with choices should be playable come phase 4 release, for now though? A tease!

Just released is the start of The Xiao Trials which introduces you to all the familiar characters plus one extra and let's you get a feel for Dr Alleyne's 'quirky' personality.

notes.title: 1 Year Anniversary! Update News!
notes.content:
[b][u]Celebrating the one year anniversary of Anna: The Series Test! A huge thank you to everyone![/u][/b]

Crazy to think that The Series Test has been on sale for one whole year! Honestly the time has flown by, and I'm ever so grateful to everyone single one of you who has played or shown interest in the game. It's even crazier to think that this started for as a hobby to pass the lockdown isolation and now we're here. One year on.... Wow.

[i]As always, a sidenote first. In all truthfulness this anniversary sorta crept up on me, and I've been working so hard on getting phase four ready that I didn't have any time to do anything special to celebrate. So unfortunately, no anniversary update. :(  This announcement is more going to be a big thank you and a few insights to the test and how it was nearly completely different.[/i]

[b][i]A side-sidenote, as a thank you to everyone who has offered advice, feedback, been active in the discussions and announcements. Plus backed me on patreon. In the next update I'm going to include a thank you wall with all your names on it! (If you don't mind, obviously) I want to give back where I can and this seems doable. :) [/i][/b]

[b]Going to put the stuff about the journey here first and update news at the bottom, so scroll down if you just after that. :) [/b]

Anyway, guess I'll begin with how mad it is that we've come this far from where The Series test started. I apologize for only having one major update in the last year, but due to how winding this game is, and it being set in stages kinda helps, it seems ideal to update with each phase. We're now three phases down with two more left! The next update will be end of phase 4, then the last update should be phase 5 with all the endings tying every up. [b]Achievements will also be hopefully integrated with phase 5! [/b]

This last year has been a journey for me and taught me a lot about game creation, like the do's and don'ts. Like I learned not to render everything as a PNG and at the same time learned to listen to my gut. Also learned a hell of a lot more about the software I'm using allowing the renders to get better with each phase out.

[b]On that note:[/b] This phase I've gone back and re-worked the town intro and rendered everything again using the skills I've picked up over the last year. So next update, when you enter The Series Test again, everything should look much crisper. 

[b]Now we're a year deep into the Series Test, I dread to imagine what it would feel like without the sadistic yet loveable Dr Alleyne running the show, truth is though, she nearly wasn't there at all.[/b]

During the first draft of the Series Test and all the way up to the start, Alleyne didn't exist, neither did Aer-dula.
The original plan was to never reveal who you, the volunteer, were until the ending phase, yet during the town intro I needed a set of legs to render so I created Alleyne. (Go back and watch the town intro, those are Alei's legs.) And then when I needed someone to introduce the test I already had Alei so she took the role.

Kinda like dating Alleyne, that was never meant to happen, yet to counter Cherry's loveable sweet dating route, I wanted something darker. so in come Alleyne again... But She was also you, and I needed to correct that which gave us Aer-dula, you, the Volunteer.
After that while writing the story I wanted to give these woman more of a backstory like the replicas had, problem was I had the replicas stories already written through my books. These women were blank sheets and had endless opportunities and it was a blast to give them the backstory they have.
Giving the Xiao's a past and a future, turned the Series Test from a straight shot to the finish to this convoluted love story. After all if you've travelled that route then you know why they are in Series Shores. For love.

[i]I dropped so many hints about the Xiao's relationship in phase 2, before it was reveled in phase 3. From writing on their clothes, to slipped sayings, and if the Chinese was translated there was dead give away there. One player actually pointed out their relationship before phase 3 revealed it. And to honour that, Alei actually makes a comment in her route, (Phase 3, 2nd home visit, about how this player already sussed it ages ago.)[/i]

[i]If anyone has any suspicions about where things are going, Let me here them! Get it right and I'd love to include you in the game. :) There's already loads of hints in phase 3 about phase 4.[/i]

Not only with the Xiao's but true routes were never going to be a thing either. It ended when it ended, on each replicas single path, but their backstory gave me the opportunity to bring in the real people who these replicas are based off, which in turn, gave me the chance to make secret endings. The true routes. A way to see the actually people you learning about... Take Aiko for example, A few people have mentioned to me about her backstory and how sad it is, well the true routes give you chance to meet the actual women they happened to. See how close she is to her replica.

Likewise with dating Cherry, that was an off the cuff decision which worked wonders. Same as dating Aiko, or Freya, all being spur of the moment ideas. [i]Talking about spur of the moment ideas, this phase I've had ideas where you can possible get a secret romance ending with Kiyomi and also a secret ending where Aiko and Cherry end up together... I'm intrigued to see how they play out.[/i] 

So yeah, that's kinda why these updates take so long because when I get ideas like that I'm just like 'Yes! Do it, this can work as a story!' I mean, imagine what The Test would feel like if you couldn't date Alleyne? If you couldn't romance Cherry? Or if there wasn't varying endings where you could go off the rails?! Oh, Fantasy mode! That wasn't going to be a thing either, once again spur of the moment and now... Yeah. :)

So thank you to everyone who has stuck by and waited patiently while I just go nuts on every idea which comes to my mind. All in all, it bettered the Series Test for everyone. :) :)

[u]Lastly for the rundown on a years work. Some player choices and feedback given by the community![/u]
When people contact me via email, or in the discussions, I always ask about their choices, favourites and route on their first playthrough. So here's a few rough statistics based on those responses.
[list]
[*] The most liked replica appears to be: Alma
[*] Who got voted out first the most: Aiko
[*] Whose stayed in the longest, who most have kept until now: Freya
[*] Romance route most taken: Alleyne
[*] First true route uncovered: Freya
[*] Likely to be final candidate: Freya
[/list]

[i]Poor Cherry and Kiyomi didn't get much love. Not to say they weren't loveable, just beaten by choices. Although Freya seems to be the runaway winner. Feel any different? I'd love to hear!![/i]

[u][b]Okay, Finally update on phase 4![/b][/u]

Phase 4 is deep in development and we're getting there. Not going to over estimate my abilities, but I am making progress. So far Kiyomi's route, Freya's route and Aiko's route have all been completed leaving only Cherry and Alma left to do. Once those have been completed it'll be moving on this the true routes. Which, given once taken they are only two way pathed, shouldn't take as long to complete.

This month I've also gone back and re-rendered the entire opening sequence to make it loo more crisp and smooth. Below I'm going to upload some screenshots of the before and after.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40401367/f8cb5bd3c3d6cbf7b73205c3b2182afe8a2122d8.jpg[/img]

Plus a start has been made on the Xiao Trials! A new mode which can be played from the get go. Hopefully it'll be ready for a phase 4 release, if not just after. This time you get to play as Alleyne herself and see how the randomness and madness controls her. Pictures of that below too.

As with each update there will be a new main menu, and also a thank you/shout out screen will be incorporated. (As mentioned above.) Lastly there will hopefully, hopefully hopefully, be guide implemented into the game stating which each checkmark is and how to get it.

So yeah... Phase 4 is getting there, below I'll upload a screenshot of Kiyomi's and Freya's routes plus everything else. [b] Thank you for being here a whole year, volunteers!!! [/b]

notes.title: Phase 3 Release!!
notes.content:
[b][u]Good New Volunteers! Phase 3 of the Series Test and update V0.8 is now live![/u][/b]

[i]I'm going to put this part first as it's the most important. With phase 3 of Anna: The Series Test going live today, the price of the game will be rising over the next few days. (Pending Approval.) This won't affect anyone who has already purchased the game or purchases it before the change.[/i]

[i]This update has been another 8 months of non-stop work and passion for me, as well as doubling the amount of content Anna: The Series Test already has to offer. I just felt like I needed to be upfront about this so there isn't any surprise or confusion about pricing further down the line.[/i]

[b]Now on to the good stuff! Here's the update changes for version 0.8:[/b]
[list]
[*] 3800 New renders! Which brings the total renders in this game up from just 4000 to just under 8000. (Which is so close to doubling the original release.) 
[*] 24 new video renders and 50+ new unlockable additions to the gallery!
[*] The Series Test now sits on 85,000 lines of code which is way up from the original 32,000 version 0.7 had.
[*] 9 different unique endings! (The last news update did announce there was 12, which is still technically true. But to clarify, there's 9 different unique endings, one of which has 3 different variables. On top there is then also 10 different variations of the 'normal' ending scene depending who you have left.)
[*] Font Choices! The most requested update was to have to option to change the font used in the game. Listened and learnt, there is now 9 different options you can choose from.
[*] One new relationship opens up in the way of Miss Freya Valentina! Which if you've already 'romanced', or rather been stalked by Aiko , can open up into a three way relationship.
[*] A new form of checklist has been implemented at the end of the game, or the main menu, which will track all your progress with each Replica and Alleyne separately. So it's easier to see what routes could of been taken.
[*] The branches vary drastically more in this new update than ever before! Last time your choices did affect how the Series Test played out, but now it will becomes much more apparent how your choices are driving the test with the addition of true routes which are centered around your choices. (And even if you miss all true routes, your choices will still change each interaction for small changes to huge ones.)
[*] The secret replica has been removed! If you happened to come across her minimal presence in the original release, you will no longer see her in this one. The overall route her path was taking no longer fit with the addition of Alleyne, so she has been scarped and her story has been adapted into your character route. 
[*] Various grammar and spelling corrections have been made to make the story smoother. [i](This is still early access though so if you find any more, they are being worked on.)[/i]
[*] From the start of phase three you have the option to change your name! [i](There is an option to keep the name already chosen by or you to pick from a choice of two true names for your character. Also you are now told at the beginning of the test that you're female to avoid confusion later on)[/i]
[/list]

[i]A big change for this update is that from phase 3 onwards your character has a face and a body! Nearly everything up to this point was rendered from a first person perspective, but as The Series Test developed it became increasingly harder to render new scenes from this view without rehashing the same old stuff. (Also the sexual content has a new breath of life with another view.) So as the Series Test continues onward, you'll see more of the Volunteer you're playing as.  I hope people are okay with this change.[/i] So meet your volunteer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40401367/cddfeaffe2164683e9875ceaa37f020c369959f1.png[/img]

[b]I've already gone over what to expect from this phase in terms of story in the last news announcement, however I'll repost some of the renders along with one or two of the new checklists below for anyone who has missed those.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40401367/eb8449547dbfe02430f7962d4914080be952a15e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40401367/0758ffa19d0400a8c0a6043d2311a271019ff5f2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40401367/30900445da8b8fc4aaae5289feb9456d94a1018c.jpg[/img]

The addition of true routes is a huge step forward for The Series Test as it can drastically change the way the test will play out and in future updates some (or all) will be given branching options for endings. These begin in this phase and you will be notified at the end of phase three if you're in one of these routes. So feel free to play around with the test and see which ones you can find out of the six. [i]The requirements for these routes are all based around your choices.[/i]

[b]I'll end this here. Lastly though, I want to say there is an absolute ton of new content in this update, but with the Series Test being based around player choices and branching stories, if you're playing one solo route you will not see everything which is new. Which is fine, play it your way as it's built for you after all. There is still loads and loads of content for you. To see everything though will require more than one go around. Just a tip. Play it how you want Volunteer!! [/b]

Okay, looks like that is all. Just thanks again to everyone who has played, purchased, reviewed and been there with Anna: The Series Test. I love going into the discussions and emails to talk to you lot about what you think and what you choose, so please let me know what you think of the girls and this phase! Thank you all again! See you soon in phase 3, Volunteers!

notes.title: Update News! (Long overdue)
notes.content:
[u][b]Finally The long overdue news on what's been happening within Anna: The Series Test![/b][/u]

So starting off with the good news! Update 0.8 is finally coming close to release! I'm aware everybody is probably thinking; About time! Trust me I am too. But the delay has a good side which allowed me to include so much more in this update than originally planned.

[b]As for when?[/b] Hopefully two weeks! Definitely by the end of January.

Currently I am just adding in the button choices and the scenes which follow after and then, as Cherry would say, Boo-Yah! All done and ready for release.  

[b]What's the update going to include? Here's a quick bullet-point rundown of what to expect:[/b]
[list]
[*] 3800 New renders! Bringing the totals renders way up from 4000 to just shy of 8000. [i](Which is so close to doubling the original release.)[/i]
[*] 72,000 new lines of code! Which is all script and branching stories. The original game had 32,000 lines of code. [i](So plus 40,000 on that? I'm taking that as a personal win for me. New record.)[/i]
[*] 12 different endings on phase 3! The current game has 4 endings which are similar in context and are based around who you date. Now there is going to be 12 endings available, which are going to be very different.  [i]("This does not include how your current friendship stands with the replicas.)[/i]
[*] 17 new video animations!
[*] One new relationship opens up in the way of Miss Freya Valentina, which also can lead onto a three way relationship between you, Freya, and Aiko. If you play your cards right. [i](This is probably the most sexual the test becomes. Just throwing that out there.)[/i]
[*] The branches vary drastically more in this update than before! Last time your choices did affect how the test played out, but now your choices become so much more apparent with each story splitting on distinct paths based on how you've previously acted. [i](More on that below.)[/i]
[*] Font choices! This was probably the most requested change for the Series Test, so in the new update you will have a choice of 9 different font options.
[*] A new style of checklist at the end of the game! Track your progress even better with the updated checklist to see what you missed or what paths you could of taken. Individual checklist now for each replica and Alleyne. [i](More on that below too)[/i]
[*] Extended gallery! With 3,800 more renders there's more scenes for you to view again in the extended gallery.
[*] The secret replica has been removed! That path no longer fit with the way the test was playing and her story path has been flipped into a variation of Alleyne's path. If you find the clues. Instead, I will be replacing the secret replica with a version of the test which allows you to play through as Alleyne instead of the Volunteer. [i](Alleyne will be acting as the volunteer, with someone else taking her place. This will be available in the full release.)[/i]
[*] Fantasy mode! And of course, all of the new stories you experience in the Series Test will be available to be played again in fantasy mode, with tweaks and extra adult scenes.
[/list]

[i] On about fantasy mode, do you prefer to play the game through in fantasy mode or regular testing? I have no way of tracking which way is played most and am debating about making fantasy mode available from the get go in the future update. Any thoughts?" [/i]

[b]Now about the branching paths I was talking about?[/b]

Here's a brief expectation of what to expect for the stories in phase 3,. Also after I'll include outside interactions such as home visits and such." 
[list]
[*] Aiko:
Phase 3 will have you sharing a tea party with the insane Princess Aiko Michiyo-Sasaki and allow you the delve into her inner thoughts and how she dealt with the lose of her beloved Kiyomi.
[*] Cherry:
In phase 3 you'll take a trip to one of Cherry's treasure which happens to store memories. Not only that, you'll discover what her job actually is. Does Cherry like you enough to invite you along though?
[*] Kiyomi:
This phase Kiyomi is going to take you on an ethical question as well as reveling some of her mysterious back story. Question, what would you do if you were placed in a random room with a random stranger and asked to either kill or spare him? Kiyomi is intrigued to find out. 
[*] Alma:
Alma will either work against you in phase 3 or have you question a serial killer alongside her, depending on your relationship with her.  Have you been acting too suspicious for Sheriff Way?
[*] Freya:
Freya wants help facing her demons and standing up to Apex the company which hunted her for a decade. Now it's up to you as Volunteer whether you want to help her or leave her to struggle alone.
[*] Alleyne:
Alleyne finally thinks she has the solution to cure your visions of ghosts. But how much of your past will she be willingly to tell you to help solve your ever cracking psyche?
[*] Home visits:
This phase you can visit your home twice to see the woman or women, you have living with you. Discover Alleyne's infatuation with you, or uncover Aiko's true motives for bedding you maybe? Perhaps it's Freya you like and you'll see why she's so scared all the time. You tried dating both Aiko and Freya? Well, enjoy where that one goes Volunteer. Was it sweet Cherry which took your hand? If so you can hep her discover the joys of relationships and show her the birds and the bee's. Then again, maybe you didn't date anyone. That's fine too, the Series Test covers it all.
[*] True routes:
6 True routes are finally implemented. I say true routes when I really mean, watch the test go off the rails as the replicas do all sorts of stuff they were never programmed to do. Watch Alma go toe to toe in a battle of wits with Alleyne. Be stalked and preyed upon in your own apartment standing beside Alleyne after Kiyomi discovers too much. Had Aiko figured out what you did to Kiyomi? Keep an eye on that one. Cherry uncovers a memory she was never meant to see about her mother's murder. How will she take it? Betray Freya and see how far she will go to take revenge on those who cross her. Or partner her up with Aiko and see how submissive she'll be to be loved.
[*] Some one is missing? Who's noticed:
Alma will appear to discuss Freya's disappearance after phase two. Kiyomi will question Aiko's, Cherry will question Alma's. Freya will questions Cherry's and as always Aiko's already noted Kiyomi's. (Have you seen that yet?)
[*] Still being haunted and is that your twin?
Your visions of a replica first picked come around again this phase, but what do they mean? Make the right choices this phase in the right order and maybe, just maybe, you might end up seeing behind the mirror. She does look awfully familiar. 
[*] And as always, make your choice:
Three replicas are left at the start of phase three and there can only be two at the end. Who are you giving the boot, and are you finally about to see where they've been disappearing to?"
[/list]

notes.title: Two Month Progress Update!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Volunteers! Here to quickly give you the monthly rundown on the progress I've made towards getting the next phase out to you all! And an apology for not having it out this month like I'd originally hoped.[/b]

I'll start this by apologizing for the next phase not being rolled out this month.  I've tried my hardest to get the next phase complete for release, but unfortunately it just hasn't happened. That's not to say progress hasn't been made because it definitely has, and I'll run through that in a minute, but truthfully the delay is simply because I've just had so many new ideas and routes I want to take the test this phase and when I get ideas like that I just run with them.

For example, in the early stages of this games development Alleyne wasn't even a character who was going to be included. She wasn't implemented until months later and that was only because I needed someone to introduce you to the test. So I created Alleyne, loved the personality I'd given her and then all these mad storylines came to me on who she could be and what she could do. Now she's the biggest part of the test.  So I hope you'll all bare with me while I try to run with more ideas like these, they will only better your experience.

[b]Okay so now that is out the way I'll move on to how far phase three has come:[/b]

[list]
[*] All five main storylines have been scripted and are now in the rendering phase. This is the five main storylines which are varied based on your previous choices. Some big, some small.
[*] An example of the point above being Alma. Depending on the choices you've made with her already you'll get one of two very different paths with her this phase. Where as Freya on the other hand only has one path, which can be dismissed entirely if wanted. Still, to counter that she has a romance option which in itself has two different paths and extra scenes and conversations.
[*] When phase three rolls out you'll be able to start the 'true' routes. Two of which have been scripted to completion and are now in the rendering phase.
[*] Previously Aiko was the only person with a unique scene after the first choice. Now in phase three, four more special scenes have been added with the other women noticing people vanishing. Three of these are scripted to completion with one rendered fully.
[*] The gallery will been expanded this phase with all the new scenes which will be added.
[*] Hundreds of more renders are complete for this phase, on top of what was already finished last month.
[*] Thousands more lines of scripts have been added extending the story further than before.
[*] On top the five new outfits last month there is now another two added this month.
[/list]
The list of completed stuff may seem shorter this month, but I've mostly spent the month writing out the stories and pathways ready to move on to the rendering phase. Plus this is all on top of what was completed last month. Once more I apologize for the delay and am working as hard as possible to get this out as soon as possible. As always if anyone has any questions or ideas I would love to hear them. Feel free to email me at Annaseries22@outlook.com.


[b]If anyone is interested, lastly below I'm going to have a little section on how my work flow goes and what I do to make this game possible. It isn't important to the announcement, so skip if you want. :) [/b]

This  section is mainly here because I want to be open with you all on how I create the game, so you know time isn't being wasted, and secondly because when I was first started work on Anna; The Series Test, I had no idea what I was doing and trying to research it didn't much help.  (You never know, this might help someone else who wants to try their hand at it.)

This has very much been a learn as I go process. (Hence the file size. Accidently I rendered all of phase one as PNG's which lead to the large install data. I am working on converting phase one to JPG's, like the rest, to lower the size. But only if it doesn't effect the render quality. Sorry for this mistake.)

Anyway, I've read a lot of CG visual novels in my time and one thing what struck me was that some use the same characters, clothing and scenes as others. Pre-made and repeated over and over. Don't get me wrong, I still love the games and appreciate how well they were made and the stories they tell, but I wanted The Series Test to be truly unique which is why I personally build everything from scratch. (Bar the music and a few hairstyles.) 

All the clothing in the game I make using Character Creator 3, Marvelous Designer, Zbrush and Substance Painter. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40401367/16638fc273db4fb0e58cc89b3781fafdf4617649.png[/img]

Marvelous is used to design the outfits, make sure they fit the characters and act as real clothes would. Once done there they go through Zbrush where each fold is hand sculpted and they are further detailed. Little accent buttons and other side parts of the costumes are added. Lastly it goes over to Substance to be hand painted and designed to match the character in question. 

When the clothing is finished, I take it back to Character Creator 3 which is what is used to make the replicas to begin with. All said and done, I get something like this: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40401367/cddfeaffe2164683e9875ceaa37f020c369959f1.png[/img]

The set-pieces and all the renders are done with a mix of CC3, Substance and Iclone7. Each background/set-piece in The Series Test begins as a simple cube and is added onto from there. All scenes are hand built by me, created from tens and dozens of tiny shapes all transformed and shaped to makeup the environments and objects you see.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40401367/779ab504c6d269ac5d772aa86ee480fe4bfeb1a3.png[/img] 

Finally when the scene is built I paint it, texture it, add in the lighting, position the replicas and work a little magic with the camera and it's ready to render. Giving off this beauty:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40401367/124ef877493e7aa709a7e89a55877430a03fd318.png[/img]

So yeah, that's how Anna: The Series Test is created. I'm aware no-one really asked, but just wanted to be straight with how the process works and how much love and care is going into this game from me. Never know, might also point someone in the right direction to create their own. :) :)

[b]Thank you all again for being on this journey with me. You are all awesome! And I'll have more news for you all when the next phase is complete. Hopefully It'll be before the next monthly announcement. :) [/b]

notes.title: One month since release! Progress update!
notes.content:
[b] It's been one month since the release of, Anna the Series Test.[/b]

And honestly I'm shocked and overjoyed to see that so many people have enjoyed it this far. When I was creating this game, from the first idea up to it's release, I wasn't sure if even one person would play it so to see how well it's doing now is great.  So thank you to everyone who played it and every one who's left a review, they help out so much!! Anyway.... Enough about that, let's move on to progress.

[b]Progress made in the last month:[/b]

[list]
[*] Since release the game has been updated with a gallery so all the scenes you've viewed can now be seen when you desire. That update is already out.
[*] Currently two of the next five stories are complete, with the beginning of each characters true routes starting after the second choice if you've made the right choices so far.
[*] Scenes revolving around the discovery of who you play as a character have been added with an option to change your name after the dream sequence. For those who wish to change it to something more fitting based on the revelation.
[*] A new possible love interest, Freya Valentina, has been added in phase three. Taking the total from two and a half to three and a half. (Aiko would be the half, already in the game she is kind of romantic interest, a relative kind of.)
[*] This new love interest opens a route for having both Aiko and Freya live with you at once. A three-person relationship opening.
[*] The true routes have been established and now have starting points giving me a total amount of how many endings will available. A total of 21 unique endings. (Ten of which will have varied outcomes based on a final choice.)
[*] In phase three you have the option to visit your home to see the woman/women you have living with you. Three people are currently available to move in (Aiko, Cherry and Alleyne) two more options being added this phase. (Freya, Freya and Aiko.) Some of these scenes have been completed.
[*] 1200 renders are currently complete. With more to be done still.
[*] Thousands more lines of code and scripting have been done.
[*] It is looking as if the phase three update will be done and hopefully rolled out by mid July. I do apologize updates take a while, but this is all created by me alone and I'd rather do it right the first time for you all. 
[*] Five new outfits have been created for some of the woman. Three are showcased beneath. The other two you will see in the game.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40401367/44e5364fcbbb43ab8caefa9d56e43120f4ffbaee.png[/img]

That's as far as I have done so far which is a lot of work over the last month. Every day I'm working away to get this update out to you as soon as I can. The support has been very motivating for that. 

One last thing, many have asked how the story changes based on choices. I don't want to give the endings away but below is a diagram of how the story mapping in this game works. (If anyone can understand my rough design of it.) This is the pathing of one character, with Alleyne's route for that character below. All characters have paths similar to this with unique stories. As shown there is four different endings per character. The true route, a story purely mapped around that character if the right choices are made at the right time. A good ending, if they a aligned with you. A bad ending, if they dislike you. Alleyne's ending if you choose to pursue her.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40401367/75e1819f1c278ed59ca58763617648a1139e8f89.png[/img]

This is if you keep that character to the end of the test. So you can travel others routes, see their stories up until the point you 'evict' them. (Only one true route can be taken at a time.)

If your looking at the diagram and seeing four endings x 5 characters = 20 endings, but I said 21?... Well the last ending which won't be in the game released until the full version is the true Aldra route.

Anyway that brings me to the end. Thanks for reading so far. Hopefully you all still enjoy the game and this shows work is being made. Any questions please email me or leave something in the discussion I try to get to them a much as possible. Thank you again Volunteers!

notes.title: Gallery Update! And a big thanks to everyone who's played the game so far!
notes.content:
[b] The Gallery Update! [/b]

The newest update adds a unlockable gallery to the main menu which will allow the scenes you've come across to be viewed at your own leisure with out having to go back to find them in the story every time. Which is handy if you know what you're looking for.

It also gives out rough hints (in the form of titles) saying where these scenes maybe. The majority are in the Fantasy Mode. Handy for a completionist who wants to see everything available, but also for highlighting some scenes and routes you may not of known existed.

[b] Don't worry, Anna Series is still being worked on! [/b]

Just because the game is out now doesn't mean the work stops. Everyday I'm continuing to add more content and routes for phase three and beyond. The game will be updated with each new phase as it's complete. Roughly expect these updates to be between a month or two apart. (This is a full solo creation, meaning it takes time. Hope you understand and thanks for the patience.)

Lastly, if you did like the game so far and have the time then please drop a review or email me (annaseries22@outlook.com) to let me know what you think! This is my first game, so all the feedback and the reviews help me figure out what works and what doesn't. Helps shapes The Series Test into the best version it can be.

I will be updating here with news as much as possible. But I do update my patreon on the 15th and 30th (AnnaSeries) every month with everything I've done in the passing 15 days. It is all free! You don't need to subscribe to see the content there. I want this game to be as accessible to everyone as possible.

[b] So yeah, that's that. Once again a big thank you and shoutout to everyone who has played and enjoyed the game. Even if you didn't the fact that you were here is good enough for me! Appreciate you all! Until the next update![/b]
